data.gender_notes: Levian is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: From Levi, a Hebrew name meaning 'joined' or 'attached'
data.long_meaning: In the Old Testament, Levi was the third son of Jacob and Leah. He and his descendants became the priests and gatekeepers of the tabernacle in the wilderness and later at the Temple in Jerusalem. This name carries a rich history and a strong association with the priesthood and the religious service. The name Levian carries the meaning “From Levi, a Hebrew name meaning 'joined' or 'attached'” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Levian usually hope their child will grow to embody from levi, a hebrew name meaning 'joined' or 'attached' and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: לויאן

in_hebrew.long_meaning: לויאן הוא שם שמקורו בשפה העברית ופירושו משושנת הארון או קורא תפילה. השם לויאן קשור לשבט לוי, אחד משבטי ישראל, ששימשו ככהנים ומשרתים בבית המקדש. השם נושא עמו משמעות רבה של שירות ומסירות לאלוהים.

in_greek.name: Λεβιαν
in_greek.meaning: Λεβιαν σημαίνει αυτός που ανήκει στο Λευί
in_greek.long_meaning: Λεβιαν είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την ελληνική παράδοση και σχετίζεται με το Λευί, ένα από τα δώδεκα φυλά του Ισραήλ. Το όνομα αυτό φέρει τη σημασία του λειτουργού ή του ιερέα, καθότι οι Λευίτες ήταν υπεύθυνοι για τη λειτουργία του Ναού στην Ιερουσαλήμ.

historical_references.reference: In the early Middle Ages, Levian was a common name for a class of Christian monks known as 'Levites'. These monks were dedicated to the care and administration of the churches and monasteries, as well as the study and teaching of the Scriptures. They did not engage in manual labor or the military, but were instead focused on the spiritual life and the service of God.

Levian was known for his bravery and piety, and was often called upon by the Crusade leaders to lead important military campaigns.
